messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to flip the UI hidden-settings flag to a canary tomorrow AM for a small internal cohort. Wanted to check guardrails and rollout plan before I press the button.

jon: +1. which flag name are we using and who’s in the cohort?

maria: flag: `ui.hidden_settings_v2`
cohort: 5% internal (engineering + devex) in us-west. No customer-facing cohort yet.

sam: Suggested guardrails: 1) a fast rollback toggle in console 2) feature audit logs 3) perf & error-alerting tied to the flag 4) UX telemetry (click-throughs)

kevin: For rollback: we need a single click disable that also clears any client-side caches. Ops-bot can emit an event that triggers cache invalidation if we wire it.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rehearsal ticket created: #DEP-4112. Will post rollout task checklist 15m before canary start.

maria: Nice. Metrics I care about: render latency p50/p95 for console settings page, JS exceptions rate, and # of users hitting the hidden settings path.

jon: Add a quality guard: if JS exceptions > 0.5% in 10m window, auto-disable and page oncall. Can we hook that to Alertmanager?

sam: Yes — we can create an alert rule: `expr: (sum(increase(js_exceptions_total[10m])) / sum(increase(page_loads_total[10m]))) > 0.005` -> alert:HiddenSettingsErrors. I’ll open the PR to add the rule.

maria: Thanks. Also want a soft banner for cohort users: "You’re in an experiment — send feedback" with a link to a short form. Keep it low friction.

kevin: On rollout visibility: log each exposure event with user_id + flag_version. That will let us audit and do a scoped rollback if needed.

sam: For the canary window proposal: 2 hours ramp at 5% internal, then expand to 20% internal for 2 days if no alerts, then staged customer canary (SSO orgs only) after product sign-off.

maria: Timeline sounds good. I’ll schedule the canary for 09:00 PT tomorrow. Sam — can you PR the alert + logging changes today? Kevin — can you add the rollback toggle to the console quick actions? Jon — can you own the post-rollout notes and comms?

jon: I’ll draft a short rollout note + comms to #general and support docs, and prepare a rollback playbook snippet.

kevin: I’ll add the toggle and wire ops-bot for cache invalidation. ETA end of day.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/1234 — adds alert & exposure logging.

maria: Perfect. Ops-bot — please remind us 30m before.

ops-bot: reminder set for 2027-06-09T08:30:00-07:00 (canary start 2027-06-09T09:00:00-07:00).

maria: Thanks all. Will post a final checklist before the run. :thumbsup:
